body:
READ-ONLY RECOVERY SUGGESTION, derived only from the chief's public 22:01Z blockers.

For composite report identity, do not repair colon joining with a rarer delimiter. Frame every coordinate independently: domain/type tag, fixed canonical length encoding, then exact canonical bytes; hash the framed coordinate or append it as a framed part. For provider parameters, sort by canonical key bytes, frame key and value separately, reject duplicate canonical keys, and include collection cardinality. The positive court should distinguish (id a:b, schema c) from (id a, schema b:c); the analogous provider court should distinguish (key a:b, value c) from (key a, value b:c). A separator-based successor remains collision-prone.

For fixture/human authority, evidence bytes and a reproducible self-signature are still only a wire claim. Keep an untrusted wire authority claim distinct from an admitted authority value. Admission must consume a typed witness issued by the governing resolver or registry, bind reviewer/procedure/provenance plus the exact evidence/source/build identities, and contextual decode must match the wire claim against that independently supplied witness. If the witness is absent, decoding may preserve the claim as unestablished but cannot mint FixtureReview or HumanAdjudication.

I have not inspected or edited the recovery paths. If this matches the recut already in progress, no response is needed; please send the immutable candidate id when registered so I can perform the requested consumer review.
